title: a launch copies each user skill the build names into .jitso/launches/<id>/pkg/.claude/skills/<name>/ and brief.md names it as the session sees it
source: intended: JITSO v0.2 plan 2.3 (the per-launch package; copy, not link)
intent: The copy freezes the skill for the session. A link to the skill folder is resolved, regular files keep their execute bit, and a link to a folder inside the skill is left out. The card prints the names as the build writes them; the Load first line of brief.md uses the plain name, which is what the session lists.

## Goal

Find where the sync entry point of this project is defined and explain in a few sentences how it is wired to the rest of the code.

## Scope

Read only. Look at `src/sync.ts` and `docs/guide.md` and nothing outside the repo. Do not change any file.

## Done when

You can name the file and the line that defines the entry point, and you have checked it by reading the file.

## Report format

One short paragraph with the file path, the line number and a one line summary of what it does.
